name: Tangtangjia Homestay
aiSummary: What are the check-in and check-out times at Tangtangjia Homestay?
address: Building 10, Huashengda Mountain Villa, No. 205 Huangfu East Road, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 1️⃣設施：設備齊全，靜音效果做的特別好，花很大的心意和精力，很棒，把住宿居住安靜的效果，做到了極致，很為客人考慮，因為我經常去過全國各地旅行，晚上的睡眠質量， 要求就很重要，外界的聲音，會把在睡夢中的我吵醒，店家這裏就做的不錯，這點特別贊👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 2️⃣衞生：乾淨整潔，把7S管理做的很好，整體都很舒服的感覺。 3️⃣環境：沒得説，整個院子房間做的好奈斯，設計風格也很棒，因為是來參加，2025凱樂石莫干山跑山賽，的參賽選手，距離起點特別近，在比賽的過程，把莫干山景區，跑遍了，感覺很好，下次還來。 4️⃣服務：老闆和老闆娘接待顧客，都很好，温文爾雅風度翩翩，也喜歡運動，洋溢着積極向上的既視感，很注重健康，性格開朗。 最後的最後，推薦大家光臨她/他們家，有驚喜！ 以上（完）。——2025.10.24
comments.author: Lijinggunzhongxuntixichuangshiren
comments.quoteEn: On the fittings: everything is there, and the soundproofing has clearly taken real effort and thought. They have taken it as far as it goes, which shows they were thinking about the guest. I travel all over the country and sleep matters to me, and noise from outside wakes me. This place has it right. On cleanliness: clean and tidy, well organised, comfortable throughout. On the setting: nothing to add, the courtyard and the rooms are lovely and the design is good. I was here for the 2025 Kailas Moganshan trail race and it is very close to the start. The route took in the whole scenic area and it was a good day. I will come back. On service: the couple who run it look after guests beautifully, courteous and easy company. They are into sport themselves, health minded and cheerful. Go and stay with them, there are surprises in it.
